_help: Copy this file to settings.json (Install.cmd does it for you) and fill in your details. settings.json stays on your PC and is not uploaded to GitHub.
_help_models: haiku is fastest; sonnet gives better answers but is slower and uses more of your Claude limit.
_help_invites: AskAboutInvites lists unanswered meeting invites in the next InviteDays at the top of the dashboard, with Open and Dismiss buttons.
_help_other: CloseOutlookOnExit quits Outlook when you close the dashboard (never while a draft window is open). Port only needs changing if 8000 is taken.
